environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS 1.28 with a hardened pod security context. The container securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. A Cilium L4 network policy is attached to the pod's namespace restricting egress to port 8080 on service CIDR 10.96.0.0/12 and port 443 on 0.0.0.0/0 (for external OAuth providers). The policy uses a CiliumNetworkPolicy with egressDeny rules for 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local) and 10.0.0.0/8 except the service CIDR. Node-level iptables PREROUTING chain has a DROP rule for packets from pod CIDR destined to 169.254.169.254. Additionally, the EKS node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required) with hop limit set to 1, preventing containerized workloads from reaching IMDS even if network access were possible.

config.node_iptables: DROP packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254
